title: Real recorder session promotion
minimumPromotionPolicy: Recorder promotion requires runtime RECORD_AUDIO prompt ownership, foreground microphone disclosure with stop action, ResourceRegistry-backed session handles, scoped temporary output ownership, crash and provider-destroy cleanup, packaged start/stop stress, stable denial without capability or Android permission, Safe downgrade, and raw object denial.

readyEvidence.summary: P14-24 imports P13-26 recorder status, packaged boundary smoke, and fail-closed start/stop evidence.
P15-18 keeps settings/power high-privilege behavior unpromoted before recorder promotion proceeds.
P15 contracts keep recorder at provider_poc until every opt-in promotion evidence bar is satisfied.
Recorder disclosure, provider-disable, Safe downgrade, and crash circuit breaker requirements are declared before runtime authority changes.
P15-19 is mapped to pro.tasks_device_media with the disable_recorder_provider rollback hook and permission lifecycle evidence class.

openBlockers.requiredEvidence: Runtime RECORD_AUDIO prompt and denial/grant archive covering interactive and packaged flows, stable errors, Android permission metadata, and Safe downgrade behavior.
Foreground microphone disclosure and stop-action archive proving user-visible ownership, notification cleanup, task removal behavior, and rollback cleanup.
Scoped temporary output archive proving owner-scoped paths, no raw file descriptors, delete-on-stop/delete-on-destroy behavior, quota enforcement, and failure cleanup.
ResourceRegistry session archive proving provider destroy, process death, app relaunch, crash recovery, and Safe downgrade stop owned sessions without touching external media.
Packaged recorder start/stop stress archive covering relaunch, task removal, missing capability, missing Android permission, denied prompt, quota, and temporary file cleanup.
Provider-disable Safe downgrade proof that stops owned sessions, deletes owned temporary outputs, and keeps recorder start denied.

Security regression coverage proving raw MediaRecorder, AudioRecord, AudioManager, AudioPlaybackCaptureConfiguration, MediaProjection, ParcelFileDescriptor, Uri, Context, foreground service handles, file descriptors, and Java objects remain denied.
P15-22, P15-23, P15-25, and P15-26 sync before recorder can be marked promoted.
